subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/zswap: plug the writeback IO of an LRU walk

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the writeback IO of an LRU walk in the zswap module by allowing the block layer to merge pending writes that cannot be batched together. This is achieved by plugging the LRU walk, which reduces the number of write requests and improves performance. The patch includes benchmark results showing a 6.8% reduction in write requests and a 21.6% reduction in iocost debt when running alone, and a 4.6% reduction in write requests and a 10.6% reduction in IO full pressure when running next to a sibling fio random writer.
